slides.texte_overlay:
rules for being alone
without feeling lonely

make plans with yourself

plan your alone time like a date: a film, a walk, a new café. treating your own company as something worth planning turns empty hours into time you enjoy.

keep a routine

eat, move and sleep at regular times, even when nobody is watching. a gentle rhythm keeps your days feeling full instead of long, shapeless and lonely.

talk to strangers a little

say a few words to the barista or the neighbour. tiny moments of connection add up, and they quietly remind you that you're part of the world around you.

keep your mind busy

fill some quiet hours with learning: a myth, a planet, a painting. a curious mind is rarely lonely, because it always has something interesting to explore.

write things down

keep a small journal of thoughts and funny moments. putting your days on paper feels like talking to a friend, and it helps you notice how much you live.
